subject: Routine review: facilities portal account (ITSD-118377)
body:
Hello,

A routine review has been opened for the shared 'facilities' account after
staff reported that it 'knows things'. IT does not believe the account knows
things. Accounts do not know things.

No action is required at this time. If the review finds anything unusual, the
password will be rotated, which it should have been in 2019.

subject: [CONFIDENTIAL] Internal Record FI-0001 — Facilities Irregularities
body:
INTERNAL RECORD FI-0001
Classification: PEOPLE-RELATIONS / CONFIDENTIAL
Subject: B. Achterberg (Office Manager, HPCG Dunmore)
Status: Under observation (passive)

Handling Procedures:
  Staff are not to confront the subject about kitchen inventory, room bookings
  or the thermostat. Questions about pod selection are to be routed to People
  Relations in writing. The subject is to be greeted normally. Normally.

Description:
  Over the past several business days, office logistics at HPCG Dunmore have
  changed in ways that correspond to remarks made by staff in meetings, in chat
  channels and, in at least one case, a private conversation the subject did
  not attend.

  The subject denies involvement. The subject's denial was described by three
  separate witnesses as "exactly what she would say."

  Productivity in the affected area is up 9%. Complaints about the kitchen are
  down 100%. Staff report a feeling of being "gently observed".

Addendum FI-0001-A:
  Brightwater Coffee Services confirms the orders came through the facilities
  portal. The portal account's password has not been changed since 2019. People
  Relations has chosen not to pursue this line of inquiry, as it is an IT matter,
  and IT has asked us to stop calling.

Addendum FI-0001-B:
  A second actor is [[R6:not suspected]].

Addendum FI-0001-C:
  Recommended action: none. Recommended disposition toward the subject:
  respectful.

-- end of record --

This message was sent to you in error. Please delete it. Please do not tell
anyone that you were sent it in error.
